snippet.title: New Game Pool Glow
snippet.description: Pool Glow is an immersive exploration game inspired by poolcore aesthetics. You are free to wander through bright, open pool spaces, observing the gentle interplay of light and shadow. You can slow down, explore at your own pace, and discover a quiet sense of peace and relaxation.   https://store.steampowered.com/app/4555850/Pool_Glow/
